हपुषा हपुषा, f., N. of a particular sub-
stance forming an article of trade (commonly called
Habush, and said to be of a long form and black
colour, and smelling like raw meat or fish; it is of
two kinds).

हापन, अम्, n. the act of causing to quit or
abandon, expelling.

हापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be relinquished;
made to give up.
हापुत्री हापुत्री, f. a kind of wagtail.
